description: This file contains functions for managing UBI device preparation and updates, specifically for Buffalo devices in an OpenWrt context. It includes procedures for attaching UBI volumes, removing volumes, creating volumes, and updating firmware hash volumes.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices by removing specific volumes related to the root filesystem, firmware hash, and user properties.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Creates necessary UBI volumes and updates their firmware hash volumes for recovery and upgrade purposes.
